notes: Characters shop for what they actually need. If someone has a date, party or formal event coming up and nothing fitting to wear, nothing to sleep or train in, or is tired of wearing the same few things, they plan a clothes-shopping trip in their free time (it shows on the Events calendar). They pay with their own money, buy something in their own style, and it goes into their wardrobe. Sometimes it's the wrong size and they return it a day or two later for a refund. In scenes they may mention it, or ask you to come along.
